reasoning:
Hard gate failure: kelvin_ok=false. SENSEC1_HI and SENSEC1_LO are both unrouted (full Kelvin pair stranded), and SENSEC2_HI is also unrouted. Per-cable current accuracy is entirely dependent on the 4-wire Kelvin topology; a stranded sense net makes cable-1 current measurement non-functional and cable-2 degraded. DRC=33 and unconnected=4 compound this. The diffpair (USB) gate passes cleanly. The directed stub set covered CAN_H/I2C lines but NOT the Kelvin sense nets -- this is the key structural gap: FR has no forced entry point on the critical SENSEC*_HI/_LO inner-shunt-tap segments, so it routes bulk signals across the escape corridor and strands the sense pairs.

New scoring finding: the kelvin_unrouted metric carries ZERO injected penalty today. With no signal, FR treats an unrouted Kelvin net identically to any other ratline, and the optimizer never preferentially prioritizes it. Adding a heavy per-pair penalty on kelvin_unrouted (200/pair) makes each stranded Kelvin pair cost 4x more than a DRC violation in the objective, biasing future seeds toward routing the sense pairs first. This is calibrated so one unrouted Kelvin pair (+200) outweighs four DRC violations (4*50=200) -- appropriate since a DRC violation is a fabrication defect while a Kelvin miss is an electrical function loss.

Manager rule: the root cause is that SENSEC*_HI/_LO have no directed stubs guiding their inner-shunt-tap escape, so FR routes bulk copper across that corridor. The fix is to add short LOCKED stubs for each SENSEC*_HI and SENSEC*_LO from the INA238 sense pad to the shunt inner edge before releasing to free routing -- this is precisely the same mechanism already applied to CAN_H/I2C, but applied to the Kelvin tap segments.

scorer_penalty.rationale: kelvin_unrouted currently carries no injected penalty, so FR treats stranded Kelvin sense nets as ordinary ratlines. Weight=200 makes one unrouted Kelvin pair cost as much as four DRC violations (4*50), biasing the objective to solve Kelvin connectivity first without overwhelming the DRC and unconnected signals.

manager_rule: When kelvin_unrouted > 0, add directed LOCKED stubs for every SENSEC*_HI and SENSEC*_LO net from their INA238 sense pad to the corresponding shunt inner edge (same waypoint mechanism already applied to CAN_H/I2C_SCL/I2C_SDA), so FR has a forced entry point and routes into the tap window instead of across it.
